message.content: Mark DeSaulnier (D) runs for CD-10, United States House of Representatives. CAIR Action endorsed him in the general; Vote for Peace supported him as an Ally. Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club endorsed him (primary, carried forward); JStreetPAC endorsed him. He voted No on the $14 billion Israel weapons package (2024) and the $3.3 billion Israel aid in State Department appropriations (2026), and Yes on the Massie amendment eliminating that $3.3 billion. He sponsors the Block the Bombs Act and the UNRWA Funding Emergency Restoration Act. In 2025 he stated he no longer votes for offensive military aid to Israel and called Gaza "unacceptable by any standards of humanity." Vote for Peace reports he does not currently accept AIPAC/DMFI funds. Contrary votes include Yes on a 2024 resolution standing with Israel against Iran, Yes on a 2026 appropriations bill with $3.3 billion for Israel, and Yes on a 2023 resolution affirming Israel's right to exist. He did not sign the November 2023 bilateral ceasefire letter and does not sponsor the genocide-recognition resolution.
